info.title: Fenergo Nebula Reporting Query
info.description: Reporting Query API is part of FenX eco-system to manage Reporting. All the operations require valid access token obtained from Identity service.

post.description:
Returns the list of entities created within a specified date range. Limit: 10000 entities, for more, please use the /file API

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: ReportingAccess

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

200.description: Success. Entity report for specified criteria is returned

messages.message: Access denied. Following permissions are required: Permission1, Permission2

401.description: User is not authorized to perform this request
